name: Rank badge
material: silk textile; silk thread; gilt thread
summary:
This is a badge of rank for a court official of the Manchu-ruled Qing Dynasty of China (1644 - 1911). It is one of a pair, and both badges were made to adorn the front and back of a navy blue surcoat worn by court officials during ceremonial and courtly functions.
